neighbours.label: postnominal superlative 'most' (the X most ADJ to ...)
fire: Doctors focused on the patients most likely to benefit from surgery.
The regions most affected by the flood received aid first.
Teachers chose the books most suitable for young readers.
Investors sold the stocks most exposed to rising rates.
We interviewed the workers most familiar with the old machines.
Officials closed the roads most damaged by the storm.
The team studied the birds most sensitive to noise.
Funding went to the schools most in need of repairs.
quiet: Doctors focused on the most likely candidates for surgery.
The worst affected regions received aid first.
Teachers chose the most suitable books for young readers.
Investors sold the most exposed stocks as rates rose.
We interviewed the most experienced workers about the old machines.
Officials closed the most damaged roads after the storm.
The team studied the most sensitive birds in the forest.
Funding went to the neediest schools for repairs.

notes: also fires on ' and' in 'written by and starring' (0.94 in probe); label covers only the 'most' part
